items.label: auf abwegen
items.context: Formed in Nottingham in 1982, O Yuki Conjugate developed an ambient practice centred on Andrew Hulme and Roger Horberry from post-punk and industrial influences. German experimental imprint auf abwegen issued the original Sleepwalker edition, assembling ten pieces from performances across nine countries as a soundtrack to Hulme’s film, with a Keeley Forsyth contribution.
items.dig_sentence: Then explore O Yuki Conjugate’s artist catalogue for the wider history around Sleepwalker.
items.why_candidate: Adds historical depth without defaulting to an obvious ambient canon primer, with a live-source and film premise suited to exploratory soundtrack interests.

items.label: Spirituals
items.genre: tape-processed ambient, experimental electronic, deconstructed house
items.context: Tokyo-raised, Saitama-based Kobayashi moved from house releases toward ambient and experimental composition, with childhood choir experience informing her harmony. Spirituals, Phantom Limb’s sub-label for emotive ambient and experimental work, presents compositions edited, looped, distorted and time-adjusted through cassette processing before studio reworking.
items.why_candidate: A new artist and imprint with a concrete creative process, promising for Slowfoam and beatless-but-electronic home listening.
